init_verifier_agent: initialize a Verifier agent with an optional config path for docstring quality verification
verify_docstring_quality: verify the quality of a generated docstring against a code component using the Verifier process method
check_docstring_completeness: check if a docstring has all required sections like summary, args, and returns using the Verifier agent
evaluate_docstring_information_value: evaluate whether a docstring adds value beyond repeating the code using the Verifier process method
assess_docstring_detail_level: assess if a docstring has appropriate detail level without exposing unnecessary implementation details
